Sent: 8/01/2309

Due to witnessing numerous ethics violations at Hephaestus, I quit.

This is my 180th report about the severity of the situation. 

What Hephaestus is doing in these mines will cause the biome to become unstable in the short-term and it will ruin our environment permanently in the long run. Read my studies if this is unclear... if anyone reads this at all. What a waste.
